hook.name: INUPOOLFeeHook
hook.description: A flat 0.05% (5 bps) ETH fee hook for INUPOOL pools. On buys (ETH → token), the fee is deducted from the ETH input via beforeSwapReturnsDelta; on sells (token → ETH), it is deducted from the ETH output via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Fees go directly to each pool's registered fee recipient. Pool initialization is restricted to the bound factory, and exact-output swaps are rejected.
